items.title: 2.1 Atomic number, proton number aur nucleon number; element ki pehchan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.1, printed pages 23-24.

blocks.text: 1913 mein Moseley ne dekha ke jab mukhtalif elements par cathode rays maari gayin to kuch khaas (characteristic) frequencies wali X-rays paida huin. Pata chala ke X-rays ki frequency ka square root (jazr) element ke atomic number Z ke directly proportional hai, yani Z barhe to yeh bhi usi hisaab se barhta hai.
Moseley ne nateeja nikala ke yeh number, yani atomic number Z, har element ki ek bunyadi pehchan (fundamental property) hai. Isay proton number bhi kehte hain.

blocks.title: Nucleon number
blocks.text: Atom ke nucleus mein protons aur neutrons ki kul tadaad ko nucleon number (A) kehte hain. Isay mass number bhi kehte hain.
Atomic number aur mass number ka rishta is equation (formula) se likha jata hai:
Yahan N neutrons ki tadaad hai. Kisi element X ka atom, jis ka atomic number Z aur mass number A ho, is tarah likha jata hai: A oopar aur Z neeche, symbol ke baen taraf.

blocks.text: Is se saabit hota hai ke atomic number aur proton number ek hi cheez hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Ion banane mein sirf electrons aate jaate hain. Positive ion (jaise Al³⁺) mein charge jitne electrons kam, aur negative ion (jaise Cl⁻, O²⁻) mein charge jitne electrons zyada. Protons (Z) aur neutrons (A − Z) kabhi nahi badalte.

items: Moseley: X-ray frequency ka square root Z ke proportional hai; atomic number = proton number.
Nucleon (mass) number A = protons + neutrons; N = A − Z.
Ion mein protons aur neutrons wahi; electrons badalte hain: Al³⁺ ke 10, Cl⁻ ke 18 electrons.
